# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_MEANREVERT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY gaps significantly (>0.5%) opposite the prior close but fails to hold VWAP in the first 15 minutes, institutional/fade participants often push price back toward VWAP as the gap proves unsustainable. This strategy captures mean reversion by fading gaps that show early VWAP disrespect, profiting from intraday participants who incorrectly assumed gap continuation.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Calculate gap_pct = (open - previous_close)/previous_close. If gap_pct > 0.005 and 15-minute bar close < VWAP, enter short at 15-minute bar close. If gap_pct < -0.005 and 15-minute bar close > VWAP, enter long at 15-minute bar close.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at extreme of gap bar (high for shorts, low for longs). First target at VWAP (~0.5R). Remaining position trails with 1 * ATR chandelier exit.  
**Regime filter:** Only trade 09:45-11:30 ET when VIX between 15-25. Avoid VIX < 12 where gaps tend to fill quickly.
